words.example: Give the new clerks time to adapt before you judge how fast they work.
words.exampleZh: 在评价新文员干活快慢之前，先给他们时间调整适应。

words.example: Adjust the seat list slightly so both interpreters sit side by side.
words.exampleZh: 请微调座位名单，让两位口译员并排就坐。

words.example: Document the decisions in writing before the room empties.
words.exampleZh: 在人走光之前，请把各项决定形成书面记录。

words.example: Record how the vote went before people start leaving the room.
words.exampleZh: 在大家开始离场之前，请记录表决的结果。

words.example: Note the names of anyone who came in late on the paper list.
words.exampleZh: 请在纸质名单上记下所有迟到者的姓名。

words.example: A proxy bypass for the local PACS viewer keeps images from loading slowly.
words.exampleZh: 本地 PACS 阅片端绕过代理之后，图像才不会加载得很慢。

words.example: The PAC file sends clinic browsers to the proxy and skips local servers.
words.exampleZh: 这份代理自动配置把门诊浏览器送到代理，并跳过本地服务器。

words.example: The DNS cache on this PC still points HIS to the old address.
words.exampleZh: 这台电脑的域名缓存还把 HIS 指到旧地址。

words.example: Flush DNS on the registration PC before you retry the new HIS name.
words.exampleZh: 在挂号电脑上先刷新域名缓存，再试新的 HIS 名称。

words.example: Someone put a stale lab address in the hosts file on that counter PC.
words.exampleZh: 有人在那台窗口电脑的主机映射文件里写了一个过期的检验地址。
